summary: Ellington Financial Inc. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing the pricing of an upsized $150 million offering of 7.375% senior unsecured notes due 2030, increased from $100 million. The notes were issued by certain subsidiaries and are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the Company. The offering is expected to close on September 17, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. The notes were offered under Rule 144A and Regulation S as additional notes to an existing $400 million indenture dated October 6, 2025. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repaying repurchase agreement borrowings and funding asset purchases. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
